bio.text: Katy Tyndell, a Wichita attorney, is the Democratic nominee for Kansas's 4th Congressional District and will face Republican Rep. Ron Estes in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a co-founder of Leading Kansas, a non-partisan organization, and switched her party affiliation from independent to Democrat to enter the race.
She says she grew up in a rural farming and ranching community in northeast Oregon.
